answer: Proof-of-Stake consensus reaches a zenith of security by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral. By utilizing a reputation ledger modeled like the growth rings of timber, the network weights influence against locked assets. This makes Sybil attacks cost-prohibitive, as an attacker would need to acquire a ravenous majority of the stake to subvert validation, effectively taxing each fraudulent identity proportionally to their total economic power within the decentralized ecosystem.
